Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti


Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. title: Tarjoilukeittiön keittiötyöntekijä Keisarinnaan
description:
**Oletko se ihminen, jonka ansiosta Keisarinnan tarjoilukeittiö toimii?**

Me uskomme, että jokaisessa keittiössä on yksi ihminen, joka pitää langat käsissään. Hän huomaa, jos jokin asia on jäämässä tekemättä. Hän pitää huolen siitä, että asiat tapahtuvat ajallaan. Hän löytää sujuvamman tavan tehdä asioita ja nauttii siitä, kun arki rullaa – ei siksi, että hän juoksisi sinne tänne, vaan siksi, että hänen työnsä sujuu hyvällä mielellä. Nyt etsimme tätä ihmistä meille.

**Kototiimi kasvaa vauhdilla – ja tarvitsemme kasvun mahdollistajan keittiöön**

Tällä hetkellä Kototiimillä on kaksi hoivakotia (kurkkaa www.kototiimi.fi). Kolmas avaa ovensa lokakuussa. Kasvun mukana lisääntyvät myös asiakkaat, tarjoiltavat ateriat ja välipalat, tiski, herkkujen tarve ja juhlien suunnittelu jne. Siksi tarvitsemme Keisarinnan keittiöön avainhenkilön – ihmisen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus pysyy hallinnassa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain osa keittiötä. Olet Keisarinnan sydän.

**Mitä työsi käytännössä on?**

Työsi tärkein vastuu on saada päivittäiset ateriat turvallisesti ja kauniisti tarjolle (ateriat tulevat valmiina eli emme valmista lounasta ja päivällistä), pitää keittiö siistinä, suunnitella välipaloja ja leivonnaisia sekä huolehtia, että tarvikkeita on riittävästi. Toki myös keittiön omavalvonnasta huolehtiminen on vastuullasi. Huolehdit siitä, että tarjoilukeittiö toimii täsmällisesti, ajallaan ja laadukkaasti. Sinulle tarkkuus ei ole rasite, vaan tapa tehdä työtä. Toimit myös osana Keisarinnan tiimiä. Perehdytät, neuvot ja kehität toimintaa aterioiden ja keittiön näkökulmasta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Haluamme, että osaaminen kasvaa koko tiimissä – ei vain yhdellä ihmisellä. Kaikki auttavat toisiaan, koska meillä yksi asia yhdistää kaikkia: **Ketään ei jätetä yksin.**

**Me innostumme ihmisistä, jotka kehittävät.**

Ehkä huomaat usein miettiväsi:\_"Tämän voisi tehdä vähän fiksummin."\_Silloin saatat viihtyä meillä erinomaisesti. Emme etsi ihmistä, joka vain ylläpitää nykyisiä toimintatapoja. Etsimme ihmistä, joka uskaltaa kysyä, voisiko tämän tehdä paremmin. Kasvavassa yrityksessä mikään ei ole valmiiksi kiveen hakattua. Juuri siksi pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Kototiimin Keisarinna rakentuu.

**Millainen sinä olet?**

Pidät järjestyksestä. Nautit siitä, että asiat ovat järjestyksessä ja tehtynä ajallaan. Rakastat työskennellä keittiössä. Vaikka meillä et valmista ruokaa alusta asti, pidät leipomisesta ja muusta värkkäämisestä ruoan ympärillä.

Sinulla on kokemusta keittiötyöstä, leipomisesta ja keittiöhygieniasta. Tai ehkä polkusi on ollut aivan toisenlainen. Meille tärkeintä on asenne.

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

Saat vakituisen työn yrityksessä, joka kasvaa voimakkaasti ja jossa omaan työhön voi oikeasti vaikuttaa. Saat vastuuta, luottamusta ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Saat työyhteisön, jossa autetaan toisia, iloitaan onnistumisista ja tehdään töitä yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. Ja mikä tärkeintä – saat työn, jolla on valtava merkitys asiakkaillemme.

Vaikka et työskentelisi päivittäin asukkaidemme kanssa, vaikutat siihen, että heidän arkensa toimii. Kun keittiö toimii hyvin, koko hoivakotiyhteisö toimii hyvin.

**Jos tunnistit itsesi...**

...älä jää miettimään, täytätkö jokaisen kohdan. Jos ajattelet, että voisit olla juuri se ihminen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus toimii vähän paremmin, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Tule rakentamaan Kototiimin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta. Meillä tärkeimmät työt eivät aina näy ulospäin – mutta niiden vaikutus näkyy joka päivä.

title: Doctoral researcher in computational weld mechanics
description:
Do you want to build a research career in computational weld mechanics? Join LUT University as a doctoral researcher and become part of an international research team developing advanced simulation methods for welded high-strength steel structures.

What your work will be like

Your work will focus on the analysis of local heat-affected zone (HAZ) behaviour in welded high-strength steels through computational weld mechanics (CWM) and phase-transformation modelling.
The research combines thermo-metallurgical and phase-transformation modelling, simulation of microstructural evolution in weld heat-affected zones, and modelling of local mechanical properties such as hardness, strength and strain-hardening behaviour. In addition, the work includes experimental characterisation of welded joints using microstructural, thermal and mechanical measurements and the validation of predictive models for performance-driven design of welded structures.

You will contribute to the development of next-generation simulation methods capable of accurately predicting local property variations in welded high-strength fossil-free steel structures.

You will be part of the Welding Technology Unit and the Steel Structures Unit at the LUT School of Energy Systems. Approximately 25 researchers are involved in these units, which collaborate closely with national and international partner universities, such as University of Oulu (Finland), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden) and Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany).

What we expect from you

You have a master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant field such as mechanical engineering, materials engineering, welding engineering, computational mechanics, or another relevant discipline, and the ability and motivation to complete the doctoral studies within their normative duration (i.e. four years).

A solid background in numerical modelling, materials science, solid mechanics, finite element methods, programming, and/or welding technology is considered beneficial. Success in this position requires the ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively within our international research community. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for performing the duties of this role.

We expect a willingness to travel, as the position includes project-related travel within Finland, participation in international conferences, and opportunities for research mobility with partner universities in Europe.

The selected candidate must submit an application for the right to complete doctoral studies with all required appendices to the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of the employment relationship.

What we offer

At LUT, you will have the opportunity to develop your scientific expertise and research skills. Our experienced supervisors will guide you, and you will benefit from professional development opportunities.

The position is based at the Lappeenranta campus, and you are expected to be regularly present on site.

The employment relationship will start with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended for up to three additional years, depending on the progress of your studies and research.

The work starts in December 2026. The start date is negotiable. Working hours are flexible, supporting work-life balance, with a total of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 15 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2h). Fill out the online application form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A cover letter describing your motivation and suitability specifically for this position, based on your expertise acquired during studies and potential prior work experience

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the [Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/sites/default/files/2021-06/TENK_CV_template_2020.pdf)

- Scanned copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records; if the original documents are not in English or Finnish, each document must be accompanied by an official certified translation into English (or Finnish). If the degree is unfinished, please provide an official estimate of your graduation.

- Contact details of two references (if available)

- A list of publications (if any)

Each attachment field accepts only one file. If you wish to submit multiple files, please combine them into a single PDF before uploading.

We will review applications on a rolling basis. Please ensure that your application includes all required documents and is submitted through the recruitment system.

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tuomas Skriko (tuomas.skriko@lut.fi, +358 50 470 6518) or Assistant Professor Antti Ahola (antti.ahola@lut.fi, +358 50 475 2825), preferably by email. You can also reach them by phone on 25 September 2026 and 9 October 2026 from 14:00 to 15:00 (UTC+2).

title: Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor in Business Analytics (tenure track) / Biträdande professor (nivå 1), biträdande professor (nivå 2) eller professor inom affärsanalytik (tenure track)
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for a tenure-track position in Business Analytics at the level of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor

starting on 1 January 2027, or as otherwise agreed, by 1 September 2027 at the latest. The position is based in Helsinki within the subject of Statistics, which is part of the Department of Finance and Economics.

The position is part of Hankens tenure-track system and is open to researchers with the potential for an outstanding academic career. If the position is filled at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to advance through evaluations that consider merits across all relevant areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in Swedish and English. The Statistics unit, which collaborates closely with Finance and Information Systems, conducts high-quality research on financial time series. The subject seeks to strengthen its teaching and research in the application of machine learning and business analytics. The subject offers education at the Bachelors, Masters, and doctoral levels.

The Department provides a strong research environment, reflected in the growing scope and breadth of its research activities. We value high-quality research with relevance to business and economics, as demonstrated by publications in highly ranked academic journals.

Requirements

The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants for the current position are required to have a fluent command of both English and Swedish. Teaching in Swedish is expected as part of the position's responsibilities.

Applicants on the assistant professor level should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of their doctorate) with a quantitative research orientation (e.g., business analytics, data science, machine learning, management science, statistics, econometrics, quantitative economics, or applied mathematics). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research in key areas relevant to the position, including Business Analytics and the potential to provide high-quality teaching.

In addition to the requirements for an assistant professor, applicants for the associate professor level are expected to have demonstrated internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position, high levels in teaching and contributed through institutional service and societal impact.

Applicants for full professor must demonstrate that she or he is an internationally recognised researcher with continued internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position. A professor is also expected to demonstrate continued high levels in teaching, institutional service and societal impact. In addition, academic leadership, experience of PhD supervision, experience and success in applying competitive research funding, international research cooperation, academic expert assignments, and experience of service within an academic department, faculty and / or university are expected.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide high-quality academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and participate in service to Hanken, the academic community, and society.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant own expertise.

Salary

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications and performance. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information

For additional information, please contact Chair of the Department Committee, Professor Anders Löflund, anders.loflund@hanken.fi.

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline

The application deadline is October 18th, 2026. Candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply

The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- Cover letter in which the applicant specifies the position for which they are applying (professor, associate professor, or assistant professor)
- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- List of publications (with the most significant publications highlighted; maximum 10 for full professor applicants and maximum 5 for associate and assistant professor applicants. Applicants at the associate professor and full professor levels should additionally submit up to five publications for assessment.
- Teaching portfolio (proposed content [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process)).

title: Kalankäsittelijä, fish processer to Föglö, Åland Islands for Fish Industry, +6 months, AX- Föglö
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for fish processer(s) to Föglö, Åland Islands.

The job involves many different functions at the fish factory: killing, gutting, "cleaning" the fish, "collecting" roe, packing, lifting heavy boxes, among other tasks. If you have forklift skills, you can also drive a counter balance forklift. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. At Nordic Trout/Bolt.works, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
The work requires decent general strength, endurance, and proactivity. Previous experience in fish processing jobs is a plus but not necessary. You will receive orientation to the job. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. Finnish hygiene passport will be needed but we can train it for the right person. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5hr/week
- Salary: approx. 12-13 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Contract length: approx. 6 months, with good possibility to continue further as permanent employment
- Start date: Sometime during October
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has small grocery store, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car/bus. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Etsimme nyt kalankäsittelijää Föglöön, Ahvenanmaalle.

Työtehtävät pitävät sisällään monipuolisia toimintoja kalatehtaalla: kalan teurastusta, perkausta, "putsaamista", mädin keruuta, pakkaamista sekä raskaiden laatikoiden nostelua. Jos sinulla on trukin ajotaitoja, voit ajaa myös vastapainotrukkia. Työskentelyolosuhteet ovat viileät (noin +2 – +6 °C), joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Nordic Troutilla / Bolt.worksilla pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todella yhteisöllistä "työperhettä".

Kelle työ sopii?
Työ vaatii kohtalaista yleiskuntoa, kestävyyttä ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Aiempi kokemus kalankäsittelystä on plusa, mutta ei välttämätöntä – saat työhön perehdytyksen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka nauttii luonnon läheisyydestä, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella saaristossa. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan, mutta voimme kouluttaa sen oikealle henkilölle. Sinun tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan englanniksi sujuvan tiimityöskentelyn takaamiseksi.

- Työaika: 20–37,5 t/vk
- Palkka: n. 12–13 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen
- Sopimuksen kesto: n. 6 kuukautta, hyvä mahdollisuus jatkua vakituisena työsuhteena
- Aloitus: Lokakuun aikana
- TES: Elintarvikealan työehtosopimus
- Työsuhde: Bolt.worksin kautta

Tietoa työpaikasta ja käytännön järjestelyistä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupunkipalveluita: saarella on pieni ruokakauppa, kirjasto ja kuntosali, kun taas muut palvelut löytyvät Maarianhaminasta (35 min lautalla + 30 min autolla/bussilla). Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee majoituksen lähellä ja Maarianhaminaan kulkee bussi. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: yleensä asut toisen työntekijän kanssa kaksiossa. Vuokra on noin 300–450 €, ja se voi sisältää tai olla sisältämättä sähköä/vettä asunnosta riippuen (saat tarkat tiedot työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout on Suomen kalatoimialan suurin toimija sekä edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, tukkukaupassa, tuonnissa, viennissä ja kasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuotta panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändi tarjoaa laajan valikoiman herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Hae paikkaa pian: tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: ERP Service Manager – Wärtsilä
description:
About the role

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational cadence of Wärtsiläs ERP Application Development (Minor Enhancements). Following a major ERP transformation, our development machinery is accelerating, and we need a hands-on ERP Service Manager to act as the key operational glue between internal business workgroups and our external development partner.

You will manage the daily operations of enhancement requests, keeping monthly planning cycles, 1-month sprints, and SAP release dates strictly on track. Your primary focus will be supporting Wärtsilä's organization in operational delivery and ensuring our external offshore partner achieves high throughput and quality.

What can we offer to you
- Permanent and full-time work contract as Academic Work consultant at Wärtsilä
- Salary: about 4,000–6,000 EUR/month based on your background and skillset. For highly experienced candidates, a higher salary level may also be negotiated.
- Impactful role: You will play a central part in running the critical ERP development engine of a global listed company.
- Flexibility: We offer a possibility to hybrid work. Preferred office is Helsinki, but offices also in Turku and Vaasa.
- International environment: Opportunity to work in a diverse, global team and continuously improve ways of working.

Work tasks

You will ensure that the development engine runs like clockwork, driving operational accountability across functional teams and external vendor resources.
- Overseeing daily operational development activities and sprint cadences across functional workgroups (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Finance).
- Managing the operations for enhancement requests (ServiceNow) delivery from planning to release.
- Supporting the monthly planning sessions, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release readiness checks.
- Serving as Wärtsilä's operational interface toward the external application development lead and offshore development team.
- Managing the development team capacity based on agreed allocations.
- Tracking the application development KPIs to continuously optimize throughput.

We are looking for

Mandatory requirements:
- Strong track record in a Service Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar operational lead role within IT or ERP environments.
- Hands-on experience with agile delivery methodologies, sprint management, and release cadences.
- Proven capability in managing external IT service providers and vendor deliverables.
- Excellent written and spoken English language skills.

Considered as an advantage:
- Experience in working with Indian offshore development partners and managing cross-cultural vendor environments.
- General understanding of SAP environments (e.g., S/4HANA, Fiori, BTP) and release management concepts.
- Finnish language skills.

Who succeeds in this role:

You are an organized, resilient, and proactive coordinator who takes full ownership of outcomes. You possess the assertiveness to challenge vendors on deliverables while remaining a constructive, supportive partner to internal stakeholders.

Recruitment timeline:
- Interviews with Academic Work: Weeks 39-40
- Interviews at Wärtsilä: Week 41
- Final decisions: Weeks 41-42

Practicalities
- Location and remote work policy: Primarily Helsinki (Salmisaari), but Vaasa or Turku are also possible. Hybrid model.
- Background checks: The selected candidate will undergo a standard security clearance (turvallisuusselvitys) by Finnish Security Intelligence Service.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working in the field of quantum technology. The company designs and manufactures cryogenic measurement systems used in research and technology development around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you will manufacture a variety of precision components from materials such as copper, aluminum, brass, stainless steel, and POM plastic. The work is varied and includes producing small batches as well as implementing different machining solutions.

We value a careful and quality-oriented approach, an interest in machining, and a willingness to develop your skills in the role. Previous experience in CNC machining is important, but you do not need to have all the required skills from day one.

Your Responsibilities

As a Machinist, you will work as part of the Bluefors production team, manufacturing components for quantum technology systems. Your responsibilities will include operating and setting up CNC milling machines and manufacturing a variety of components in small batches. You will machine materials such as copper, stainless steel, brass, aluminum, and POM plastic. You will read and interpret technical drawings and machining programs and work accordingly. In addition, you will measure the components you manufacture, inspect their quality, and ensure that they meet the required specifications. You will also contribute to maintaining a clean, organized, and safe working environment and ensuring smooth production.

Requirements

- Previous experience in CNC machining and basic knowledge of machine operation and setup
- Ability to read and work according to technical drawings
- A careful and precise approach to work, with an interest in producing high-quality results
- Willingness to learn new skills and develop as a machinist
- Good teamwork skills and a proactive attitude

We Also Consider the Following an Advantage

- Experience with 5-axis machining and DMG Mori milling machines
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Experience machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous metals, as well as precision components
- Previous experience in small-batch production or in the technical manufacturing industry

The position is full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, working in a two-shift system. The shift cycle consists of three weeks: two weeks on the day shift (Monday to Friday) and one week on the evening shift (Monday to Thursday, with Fridays off). The evening shift runs from 2:00 PM to midnight.

The selected candidate will initially be employed by Barona Teollisuus Oy on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of continuing in a longer-term position.

If you are interested in the position and would like to develop your skills as a Machinist as part of the Bluefors production team, submit your application today using the link provided in the job advertisement. We will review applications throughout the recruitment process.

For more information about the position, please contact Ari Kumlander by email at ari.kumlander@barona.fi. Please note that, due to data protection regulations, applications cannot be submitted by email.

title: Project Planner / Senior Project Planner
description:
Are you an experienced project planning professional with a passion for industrial projects? Do you want to play a key role in large-scale investments that support a more sustainable future? If so, we would love to hear from you.
Due to growing demand, we are looking for Project Planners and Senior Project Planners to join Sweco's expanding industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will be responsible for project scheduling, progress monitoring and reporting in demanding industrial projects. Working closely with discipline leads, engineering managers, procurement managers and other project stakeholders, you will coordinate and consolidate project progress information into a clear overall view. You will support proactive project management by ensuring that project schedules and progress reporting provide an accurate picture of project status and upcoming risks.
You will report to project managers and other project leadership team members and may also work directly with clients by participating in project meetings and reviews. Depending on your experience and interests, you may take on responsibility for larger and more complex projects as a Senior Project Planner.
Our projects include a wide variety of industrial investments within sectors such as energy, process industry, chemicals, hydrogen, batteries and other industrial production facilities. At Sweco, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary project organisation together with leading experts across engineering, procurement and project management.
We have a flat organisational structure and value collaboration, initiative and continuous development. You will receive support from experienced colleagues while having the opportunity to influence project practices and ways of working.
Regarding location, we offer flexibility. The role can be based at any of our offices in Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Tampere, Helsinki, Turku or Varkaus, with a flexible combination of office-based and remote work depending on project needs.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a suitable higher education degree, for example in engineering, technology, business or another relevant field (BSc, MSc or equivalent). For the Project Planner role, you typically have around three years of experience in project planning and scheduling or project controls. Experience from industrial projects is preferred, and experience in EPCM project environments is considered an advantage. You have experience using Primavera P6, which is an essential requirement for this role. Experience with Microsoft Project is considered an advantage. Knowledge of the Front-End Loading (FEL) project model is beneficial, as is experience working in multidisciplinary project organisations.
In addition, we expect you to have:
- Experience in project scheduling, progress monitoring and reporting
- The ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, procurement and project management teams
- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
- Fluent written and spoken English
- Finnish language skills are considered an advantage

You are proactive, organised and solution-oriented. You enjoy working with large and complex projects and can identify critical issues while maintaining a clear view of the overall project situation.
What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Would you like to become our colleague?
You can apply for this position via the link below by Monday 19.10.2026. You can leave your application letter in English or Finnish. We go through applications and meet those interested in the position already during the application period, so please don't wait until the last minute.
If you have any questions about the task or working with us, Team Manager Eetu Lehtimäki will be happy to talk to you. You can reach Eetu at 050 3360561 (on weekdays between 11-12) or eetu.lehtimaki(a)sweco.fi.
Paikkakunnat: Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Tampere, Helsinki, Turku, Varkaus

title: Automation Control and Commissioning Manager
description:
We are looking for a Automation Control and Commissioning Manager to work for a 1 year project in Kotka starting from 8.10.2026 and ending on 7.10.2027

Job Description

1\. Responsible for on-site debugging of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) program for the post-processing system and configuration of the upper computer system.

2\. Responsible for data integration and communication protocol matching between the control system provided by the vendor side and the factory level DCS (Distributed Control System) in Finland.

3\. Guide the wiring inspection and signal testing of on-site sensors, actuators, and electrical cabinets to ensure control accuracy.

4\. Responsible for optimizing the fully automated operation logic and adjusting control algorithms based on the characteristics of local raw materials in Finland.

5\. Provide specialized training for local operators in Finland on system operation, fault diagnosis, and maintenance.

6\. Cooperate with the EU CE certification body to conduct on-site electrical safety and functional safety assessments.

Requirements

1.Proficient in mainstream PLC programming such as Siemens and Rockwell, as well as WinCC configuration software.

2\. Proficient in industrial field bus protocols such as Profibus, Profinet, and EtherCAT, with a fundamental understanding of industrial network security.

3\. Possess 3 to 5 years of experience in automation debugging within the chemical or lithium battery materials industry, capable of independently resolving complex communication failures.

4\. Master the source code and debugging passwords of the proprietary control logic for this project, serving as a core member in the development of the metering system control program.

title: Kotisiivooja Jyväskylään
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

title: Executive Assistant, NDF, Helsinki
description:
The Nordic Development Fund (NDF) is the joint Nordic international finance institution, established by Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden. NDFs work focuses on the nexus between climate change and development in lower-income countries and countries in fragile situations. Together with our strategic partners, we develop, launch and scale high-impact projects to support developing countries and people vulnerable to climate change.

To support smooth daily operations, effective leadership and strong internal and external collaboration, NDF is now recruiting an Executive Assistant to join the Managing Directors Office at NDF. This is a fixed-term position for one year to cover a period of parental leave. The preferred start date is mid-October 2026.

The Executive Assistant will provide high-quality administrative and coordination support to the Managing Director and selected department directors. The role reports to the Managing Director and is central to effective information flow, well-organised leadership support, travel coordination, internal collaboration and a professional working environment across NDF.

Key responsibilities

Provide executive administrative support to the Managing Director and selected department directors, including calendar coordination, correspondence, document preparation, inquiry handling, information flow and filing.

Coordinate travel and related logistics, including travel arrangements, itineraries, visas, travel-related invoices and expenses in line with organisational procedures.

Serve as NDFs travel focal point, including guidance on travel procedures and approvals, maintenance of travel guidance, compliance monitoring and support to travel safety and emergency response as a member of the ISOS Response Group.

Support departmental and organisational coordination, including agreed administrative support to department directors, internal information sharing, planning and coordination of Executive Management Committee (EMC) meetings, and serving as focal point for induction of new staff members.

Plan and coordinate internal and external meetings and events, including logistics for staff meetings and other recurring activities.

Support internal development initiatives and effective use of digital tools.

Contribute to a positive and professional working environment by acting with integrity, flexibility, discretion and a service-oriented mindset, and by carrying out other relevant duties as requested.

Key competencies, experience and personal attributes

A genuine interest in [NDFs purpose and values](https://www.ndf.int/who-we-are/about-us/purpose-and-values.html), and motivation to contribute to NDFs mandate in climate and development finance.

Relevant administrative, business or other applicable professional education.

Several years of relevant experience in an executive assistant or similar administrative role, preferably in an international or multicultural working environment.

Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to work independently, take initiative and manage competing priorities.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proactive, solution-oriented and collaborative working style.

High level of discretion, integrity and professionalism, including the ability to handle sensitive information appropriately.

Advanced MS Office skills and readiness to learn and use other relevant digital tools and platforms.

Fluency in English, both written and oral. Working proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage, and other language skills are considered an asset.

We offer you

The opportunity to work in an international organisation in the field of climate change and development finance.

Varied and meaningful work in a multicultural and multilingual environment.

A role close to NDFs leadership and organisational coordination, with broad exposure to NDFs work and stakeholders.

An opportunity for a hybrid working model and other attractive employee benefits.

Application instructions and further information:

The selected candidate will be employed directly by NDF.

Register as an applicant and complete the application form carefully, and attach your CV to your application. In your application, please highlight how your strengths support the different aspects and focus areas of the role.

title: Solution Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect to help shape the future of banking technology. You will lead the architecture of domain-oriented data products and APIs that enable critical business capabilities across the bank. Working at the intersection of business, technology and data, you will partner with architects, engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders to create scalable, secure and resilient solutions. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple delivery streams, while enabling teams to make effective decisions within clear architectural guardrails.

Your impact:
You will establish reusable data and API capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve interoperability and create value for customers and business partners.

What youll be doing:
 Lead architecture across domains
 Define and evolve the architecture vision, principles and roadmap for Data Products and Domain APIs.
 Align business capabilities, data assets, APIs and technology platforms across multiple delivery streams.
 Oversee the end-to-end solution architecture and coordinate the work of software architects embedded in individual delivery streams.
 Identify interfaces, data flows and cross-domain dependencies, and guide teams in evaluating solution alternatives.

Drive data product excellence:
 Establish patterns and standards for domain-owned data products that are discoverable, trustworthy, reusable and governed.
 Clarify data ownership, product boundaries, quality expectations, metadata, lineage and lifecycle responsibilities.
 Partner with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value and safe use of data across the organisation.
 Promote modern data architecture practices, including data product thinking and domain ownership.

Shape the domain API landscape:
 Define API-first architecture principles, design standards, governance and lifecycle management practices.
 Guide the definition of domain boundaries, API contracts, versioning, security and reusable integration patterns.
 Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, resilient, observable and easy for consumers to use.
 Support event-driven and service-oriented integration approaches where they provide clear business and technology value.

Build resilient, delivery-ready solutions:
 Define solution-level functional requirements and non-functional requirements for availability, performance, security, scalability, resilience and operability.
 Define subsystems and interfaces, allocate responsibilities and clarify interactions with the wider solution context.
 Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
 Enable Continuous Delivery and DevOps through pragmatic design guidelines, automation and investment advocacy.

Collaborate and influence:
 Work closely with Product and Solution Management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
 Contribute architectural expertise to planning, high-level design, solution demonstrations and continuous exploration.
 Help shape and realise architectural enablers, including appropriate capacity allocation for enablement work.
 Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Mentor architects and engineering teams, foster collaboration and enable decentralised decision-making.

Requirements:
 Experience and domain knowledge
 Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a comparable senior architecture role.
 A proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, API and integration solutions.
 Experience leading architecture across multiple teams, products or technology domains.
 A strong understanding of banking technology and business processes. 
 Experience with Core Banking platforms is highly desirable.
 Experience working in complex, regulated environments with demanding security, resilience and data governance requirements.

title: Ajusteur Changement IS (H/F)
description:
Titre: Ajusteur changements IS H/F
Notre passion le verre - Notre inspiration c'est vous.

Verallia, un excellent choix pour développer votre potentiel et apporter votre contribution pour un avenir durable.

Verallia est le leader européen et le troisième producteur mondial de verre, fournissant à ses clients des emballages en verre de qualité exceptionnelle depuis plus de deux cents ans. Avec environ 11 000 collaborateurs et 35 usines verrières dans 12 pays, Verallia produit plus de 16 milliards de bouteilles et pots en verre et a réalisé 3,4 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires en 2024.

Le verre est recyclable à l'infini, ce qui en fait le matériau d'emballage incontournable pour aujourd'hui et surtout pour demain. En rejoignant Verallia, vous contribuez au développement durable et à l'innovation, dans un secteur et une organisation qui sont à la pointe des solutions environnementales. Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs (-rices) de développer leur potentiel au sein d'un environnement ou chaque talent peut s'épanouir. Nous investissons et révélons votre potentiel en vous offrant des opportunités passionnantes de développement personnel et professionnel. Vous êtes invité(e) et encouragé(e) à rejoindre notre communauté mondiale profondément ancrée au sein des valeurs et des pratiques locales.

L'usine de Lagnieu fondée il y a 100 ans, compte 310 salariés, c'est l'une des 7 usines verrières de Verallia France. Elle est équipée de 2 fours en teinte blanche et a la capacité de fabriquer 1,5 milliards de pots par an. C'est la seule usine de Verallia France dédiée à la production de pots pour accompagner tous les acteurs français de l'alimentaire sur leurs marchés (confitures, pâtes à tartiner, café, sauce tomates, cornichons.).




Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, nous recherchons pour notre site de Lagnieu, un Ajusteur changements IS (h/f). Au sein d'une équipe d'une vingtaine de personnes, vous contribuez aux résultats de l'usine en remettant en état les moules et en renforçant les changements de fabrication.

En tant qu'ajusteur changements IS, vous êtes notamment en charge :

de la réparation et de la remise en état des moules
du contrôle les moules
des retouches des gravures (fonds, moules finisseurs) dont le dessin a été atténué par les fabrications et réparations successives
des changements de fabrication en collaboration avec l'atelier IS jusqu'au démarrage.
de remplacer ponctuellement le personnel 2x8. A ce titre : vous lavez et réparee les moules relais; approvisionnez les équipements moulerie en production

Poste de journée:

Lundi 7h-12h / 12h45 -15h30

Autres jours: 7h-12h / 12h45-15h

Astreinte technique week-end : toutes les 5/6 semaines.

Rémunération fixe à partir de 32000€ annuelle.

Votre profil :

Formation CAP/BEP; BAC PRO productique, mécanique, ou maintenance

Connaissance du matériel de moulerie (ajustage)

Compétences en mécanique

title: Agent / Agente d'exploitation d'usine d'incinération des déchets (H/F)
description:

Depuis la salle de commande, l'adjoint de quart pilote le pont roulant muni d'un grappin et répartit de façon homogène les déchets qui sont livrés afin d'alimenter les 2 lignes de combustion et de production de vapeur (23b ;230°C).
Il surveille et analyse les paramètres de conduite depuis les postes de supervision.

Il prend les décisions nécessaires afin d'assurer en toutes circonstances un fonctionnement adapté de ses installations.
Il diagnostique les pannes ou anomalies sur les installations et transmet ces informations à son responsable.
Il exécute les consignes d'exploitation à partir du guide de conduite.
Il réalise les rondes, les relevés techniques et les analyses d'eau.

A moyen terme, après avoir suivi un parcours de formation au CAMPUS VEOLIA, l'adjoint de quart sera titulaire d'une habilitation à conduire les unités de valorisation énergétique (diplôme de niveau 4 reconnu par l'éducation nationale).
A ce titre, il sera amené à remplacer le Chef de Quart autant que de besoin (remplacement lors de congés payés par exemple). A terme, il devra pouvoir conduire l'installation en marche dégradée, ajuster les paramètres de conduites et démarrer seul une ligne de chaudière, ou arrêter et mettre en sécurité l'installation.

Sécurité : Respecte et fait respecter les consignes de sécurité.

Maintenance des installations:

Il peut être amené à participer aux travaux de maintenance suivant un cycle défini.
Il émet toutes propositions et toutes suggestions susceptibles d'améliorer le fonctionnement, les performances, les conditions de travail, la sécurité, le service client,.

Système de management de l'Energie :

L'adjoint de quart respecte la politique énergétique et applique l'ensemble de la documentation et des consignes afférents à sa fonction.
Sous la responsabilité de son supérieur hiérarchique, il accompagne ce dernier pour collecter les informations relatives aux performances énergétiques.
Il assure le respect des procédures et des critères énergétiques.
Il communique et assure par son comportement une contribution à la bonne démarche énergétique
Il communique les éléments de maîtrise opérationnelle auprès de ses collègues et des prestataires.
Il identifie et remonte les besoins de formation.

Habilitations/ Diplômes à obtenir :

- TCVE : Technicien de Centre de Valorisation Energétique - niveau 4 - RCNP (campus VEOLIA)
- Habilitation électrique

- Formation incendie
- Caces type 3

- Pont roulant

Travail en équipe de 2 personnes (chef de quart et adjoint de quart), accompagné en journée par un directeur
d'exploitation et de son adjoint, d'un responsable de maintenance et de son adjoint, d'une équipe de maintenance (4 personnes) et d'une assistante.

Ton rôle chez nous ?

Tu intégreras notre plateau projet aux côtés de développeurs expérimentés pour concevoir des solutions mêlant développement Fullstack et IA.
Au quotidien, tu seras amené-e à :
- Développer des applications Fullstack en Node.js / Next.js avec JavaScript et TypeScript.
- Concevoir et intégrer des API et des LLM.
- Développer des solutions RAG et manipuler embeddings et bases vectorielles.
- Participer à la conception d'agents et de workflows IA.
- Tester différents modèles et travailler sur le prompt engineering.
- Réaliser des POC et contribuer à leur industrialisation.
- Participer aux projets clients, internes et R&D.
L'objectif : construire de vraies solutions utilisables, pas uniquement des prototypes qui terminent dans un tiroir.
Le profil qu'on aimerait avoir avec nous !
Tu as de bonnes bases en développement Fullstack et tu maîtrises JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js et Next.js.
Tu comprends les fondamentaux d'une application web : API, bases de données, authentification, Git, tests et déploiement.
Tu as déjà développé avec l'IA.
C'est un point important pour nous !
Nous ne cherchons pas uniquement quelqu'un qui utilise ChatGPT ou Copilot, mais une personne ayant déjà intégré techniquement l'IA dans un projet.
Tu as idéalement expérimenté plusieurs de ces sujets : LLM, RAG, embeddings, bases vectorielles, agents IA, prompt engineering ou automatisation.
Cette expérience peut venir d'une alternance, d'un stage, d'un projet d'école, d'un projet personnel ou d'une première expérience professionnelle.
Ce qui compte, c'est que tu aies déjà construit quelque chose concrètement !

Attentif-ve au bien-être et au développement de chaque enfant ;

Parce qu'ici, les enfants, les parents et les professionnel-les font vivre ensemble la crèche.

title: Fluids and Cryogenics Technician
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Cryogenic fluids are at the heart of our activities: without them, it would not be possible to conduct experiments at very low temperatures and high magnetic fields. We are looking for a technician who will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery - an activity with scientific, economic and environmental implications. The technician will also help to design our future cryogenic systems.

Your tasks:
You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments, where you will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery. In this role, you will:
- Perform regular checks to ensure that the distribution and recovery systems are working properly.
- Perform maintenance and regulatory requalification of equipment, and upgrade measurement electronics.
- Produce monthly reports on helium consumption and recovery.
- You will also participate, from time to time, in the design and construction of cryogenic systems.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 5 qualification (NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in physical measurements.
- You are proficient in the use of spreadsheets and web applications, as well as embedded electronics, and have some knowledge of mechanical engineering.
- You are a strong team player with an inquiring mind and a meticulous approach to your work. A service-oriented attitude and strong interpersonal skills would be highly appreciated.
- You are interested in developing unique devices, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.
- You are proficient in English, the working language in our international environment.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/43. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. United by our passion for progress and technology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the way for discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.

Comptabilité

description:
Vous aimez transformer les besoins d'un client en projets industriels réussis ?

Nous accompagnons les industriels des secteurs pharmaceutique et cosmétique dans la conception, le pilotage et la réalisation de leurs projets de travaux d'équipements, de construction ou de réhabilitation de locaux.

Votre rôle :
Vous pilotez et contribuez à la réalisation de projets pour le compte de nos clients , depuis l'identification des besoins jusqu'à la mise en service des installations.
Vos missions principales :
1 - Piloter les projets :
- Animer et coordonner l'équipe projet afin de garantir l'atteinte des objectifs.
- Établir et proposer le planning global du projet, assurer le suivi et le reporting auprès des parties prenantes.
- Assurer la communication entre les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes.
- Veiller au respect des délais, des budgets et des exigences qualité et réglementaires.
2 - Réaliser et superviser les projets :
- Assister les utilisateurs dans la définition et la formalisation de leurs besoins.
- Superviser ou réaliser les études initiales et d'avant-projet.
- Rédiger les cahiers des charges de consultation et analyser les offres.
- Mener les négociations et proposer une sélection de fournisseurs adaptés.
- Piloter et contrôler les études d'exécution détaillées.
- Diriger la phase de réalisation et d'installation, avec le support éventuel d'un conducteur de travaux.
- Coordonner l'intervention des parties prenantes (bureaux d'études, fournisseurs, sous-traitants) et assurer les conditions de sécurité et de coactivité.
- Suivre les essais, la réception des ouvrages et accompagner la levée des réserves.
3 - Contribuer au développement de l'activité
- Identifier les besoins complémentaires des clients et proposer des solutions adaptées.
- Participer à la structuration et au développement des activités de l'entreprise :
développer et partager les compétences et les outils, démarche RSE, formations, .

Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?
Chez nous, vous trouverez :
- Des projets variés : salles blanches, utilités, installation ou modification d'équipements de production auprès d'acteurs reconnus dans les secteurs pharmaceutiques et cosmétique
- Une organisation à taille humaine constituée d'experts
- Une direction accessible, présente sur le terrain et à l'écoute.
- Un accompagnement personnalisé dans le développement de vos compétences.

Le profil que nous recherchons :
Vous êtes Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une formation technique équivalente (Bac +5) et disposez d'une première expérience réussie sur des projets d'ingénierie en environnement industriel.
- Vous avez des expériences sur l'un des sujets techniques suivants : process et équipements de production pharmaceutique, environnements contrôlés (salle propres), traitement d'air (HVAC), utilités et fluides propres, électricité et automatisme, mécanique.
- Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication écrite et orale ; anglais niveau B2 minimum.
- Savoir-être : écoute, adaptabilité, esprit d'équipe, qualité de relation client/fournisseur, sens de l'analyse, contribution à la QVT.

Modalités :
- Travail sur sites clients, dans nos locaux ou en télétravail.
- Déplacements réguliers en Pays de la Loire et Centre-Val de Loire (1 à 5 jours par semaine)

Nos fondamentaux
- Service client : comprendre les enjeux de nos clients et leur apporter des solutions concrètes
- Exigence : viser la qualité et la fiabilité à chaque étape.
- Méthode : structurer les projets ppour sécuriser leur réussite.
- Compétences : développer en permanence nos compétences et expertise technique.
- Humilité : apprendre, partager et progresser ensemble.

Rejoindre ETREMA, c'est développer vos compétences techniques et managériales, participer activement au développement de l'entreprise et bénéficier d'un plan de formation adapté à vos besoins et ambitions.

title: Fluids and Cryogenics Technician
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Cryogenic fluids are at the heart of our activities: without them, it would not be possible to conduct experiments at very low temperatures and high magnetic fields. We are looking for a technician who will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery - an activity with scientific, economic and environmental implications. The technician will also help to design our future cryogenic systems.

Your tasks:
You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments, where you will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery. In this role, you will:
- Perform regular checks to ensure that the distribution and recovery systems are working properly.
- Perform maintenance and regulatory requalification of equipment, and upgrade measurement electronics.
- Produce monthly reports on helium consumption and recovery.
- You will also participate, from time to time, in the design and construction of cryogenic systems.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 5 qualification (NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in physical measurements.
- You are proficient in the use of spreadsheets and web applications, as well as embedded electronics, and have some knowledge of mechanical engineering.
- You are a strong team player with an inquiring mind and a meticulous approach to your work. A service-oriented attitude and strong interpersonal skills would be highly appreciated.
- You are interested in developing unique devices, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.
- You are proficient in English, the working language in our international environment.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/43. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. United by our passion for progress and technology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the way for discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.

title: RÉCEPTIONNAIRE ATELIER POIDS LOURD (H/F)
description:
Le/la réceptionnaire client est l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients lors de l'entrée et de la sortie des véhicules de l'atelier. Il/elle assure l'accueil du client, l'identification des besoins, l'ouverture et le suivi des ordres de réparation, ainsi que la coordination entre le client, l'atelier et les différents intervenants.
Dans un environnement poids lourds, il/elle veille particulièrement à la bonne compréhension des problématiques techniques signalées par le client et au respect des délais d'immobilisation des véhicules.

Principales responsabilités :
1. Accueil et prise en charge des clients
- Accueillir les clients professionnels avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.
- Identifier rapidement leur demande et leurs priorités.
- Recueillir les informations concernant le véhicule et les symptômes constatés.
- Réaliser un premier tour du véhicule avec le client.
- Vérifier les informations administratives et techniques du véhicule.
- Informer le client sur les modalités de prise en charge et les délais prévisionnels.
- Ouvrir un dossier (devis ou OR) avec les informations recueillies

2. Réception des véhicules
- Réaliser la réception physique des poids lourds, tracteurs, remorques et autres véhicules industriels.
- Compléter l'ordre de réparation à partir des demandes du client.
- Décrire précisément les travaux demandés et les anomalies signalées.
- Effectuer un contrôle visuel du véhicule à son arrivée.
- Relever les éventuels dommages ou équipements présents sur le véhicule.
- Vérifier le kilométrage, le niveau de carburant et les informations nécessaires à la prise en charge, mettre en place le kit hygiène dans les véhicules

3. Suivi des travaux
- Transmettre les demandes de travaux aux équipes techniques.
- Assurer le lien quotidien entre les mécaniciens, le chef d'atelier et le client.
- Suivre l'avancement des réparations.
- Informer le client (en coordination avec le responsable atelier) de l'évolution des travaux et des éventuels retards.

4. Devis et facturation
- Préparer ou établir les devis selon les procédures de l'entreprise.
- Demander les accords clients avant réalisation des travaux complémentaires.
- Contrôler la cohérence entre les travaux réalisés et les opérations facturées.
- Préparer les éléments nécessaires à la facturation.
- Expliquer la facture au client si nécessaire.
- Assurer le suivi des prises en charge sous garantie, contrats d'entretien ou assurances.

5. Restitution du véhicule
- Vérifier que les travaux prévus ont bien été réalisés avant la restitution.
- Contrôler la conformité de l'ordre de réparation.
- Présenter au client les travaux effectués et les éventuelles recommandations techniques.
- Informer le client des prochaines opérations d'entretien ou réparations à prévoir.
- Restituer les documents et clés du véhicule.
- Recueillir les éventuelles remarques du client et contribuer à sa satisfaction.

6. Gestion et suivi des véhicules de prêt / courtoisie
- Organiser la mise à disposition des véhicules de prêt ou de courtoisie pour les clients immobilisant leur véhicule.
- Vérifier la disponibilité et l'état des véhicules avant leur mise à disposition.
- Réaliser l'état des lieux du véhicule de prêt au départ et au retour.
- Contrôler les niveaux, le kilométrage, la propreté et l'état général du véhicule.
- Faire signer les documents nécessaires lors de la mise à disposition et de la restitution.

Qualités personnelles
- Excellent sens de l'accueil et du service client.
- Bon relationnel et aisance à l'oral.
- Écoute et capacité à reformuler les besoins.
- Organisation et rigueur.
- Réactivité et capacité à gérer les urgences.
- Esprit d'équipe.
- Sang-froid face aux situations conflictuelles.
- Sens des responsabilités.
- Capacité à travailler dans un environnement où les délais sont importants.
- Sens commercial et capacité à fidéliser la clientèle.

title: Consultant DevOps/Cloud (H/F)
description:
Ancrée au coeur de la cité phocéenne, Devoteam rassemble plus de 60 experts qui accompagnent nos clients dans leur transformation digitale. Spécialisés dans le cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud), l'IA, la cybersécurité, la data et l'automatisation des processus métiers, nous sommes leur partenaire de choix pour relever les défis de demain.

Innovative Technology : Devoteam Innovative Technology accompagne les entreprises vers un état d'esprit produit et une culture agile. Nous mettons à disposition de nos clients nos meilleures pratiques, nos méthodologies éprouvées et nous nous appuyons sur les plus grands providers de cloud pour les aider à relever les défis de la digitalisation.

Description du poste
En tant que Consultant Devops, vous intégrerez des projets stratégiques pour assurer les missions suivantes :

Automatisation & CI/CD : Accompagner les équipes de développement dans l'automatisation des déploiements vers le Cloud via des pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins) et l'Infra-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Conception Cloud : Participer à la définition des solutions techniques (sécurité, réseau, gouvernance) sur les environnements AWS, Google ou Microsoft Azure.

Modernisation d'architecture : Implémenter des environnements serverless (Lambda, API Gateway) ou microservices via la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes).

Migration & Monitoring : Conduire la migration des environnements legacy vers le cloud et mettre en place des solutions de monitoring adaptées.

Accompagnement & Change : Former les équipes de développement et de production aux démarches d'intégration continue et aux nouvelles solutions déployées.



Qualifications
Formation : De formation supérieure (Bac+5), école d'ingénieur ou Master 2 en informatique.

Expérience : Vous disposez d'une première expérience réussie dans un environnement Cloud (infrastructure, déploiement, migration, DevOps).

Soft Skills : Doté d'un excellent relationnel et du sens du service, vous êtes curieux, disposez d'un esprit d'analyse et appréciez le travail en équipe.

Méthodologie : Vous êtes aguerri aux méthodes agiles.

Langues : Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral pour tenir aisément des conversations professionnelles.
Informations complémentaires
Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement chez Devoteam ? Il comporte 2 à 3 entretiens :

- Talent Acquisition Interview : l'objectif est de faire le point sur vos compétences, votre niveau d'anglais et de valider vos éléments de motivation
- Tech & Business Interview : cet entretien vise à approfondir vos compétences techniques et à vérifier leur adéquation avec nos besoins lors d'un échange avec un expert métier
- Leadership Interview : il permet d'évaluer votre potentiel, vos ambitions et d'envisager votre évolution au sein de Devoteam.
Nous privilégions au moins un entretien en présentiel. Une prise de référence est demandée et, selon votre profil, des tests (techniques, anglais, personnalité...) peuvent vous être adressés.
Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous faisons parvenir une proposition présentant les conditions d'embauche. En cas d'acceptation, le contrat de travail est formalisé.

Le Groupe Devoteam oeuvre pour l'égalité des chances, pour la promotion de ses collaboratrices et de ses collaborateurs au mérite et lutte activement contre toute forme de discrimination. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité contribue à la créativité, au dynamisme et à l'excellence de notre organisation. Chaque candidature est donc considérée indépendamment de tout critère discriminatoire.

title: Supply chain manager (h/f) (H/F)
description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Helicopter Engines est le leader mondial des moteurs d'hélicoptères et le seul industriel à s'être spécialisé sur ce marché. Implantée dans le monde entier, la société emploie 6100 personnes dans le monde et possède plus de 2 500 clients répartis dans 155 pays et plus de 21 500 moteurs en service.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionAs Supply Chain Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and optimising our end-to-end supply chain. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll lead strategic procurement, inventory control, and purchasing operations while overseeing Noria, Warranty, Pool, and Logistics activities that keep our production and commercial goals on track. This is a high-impact role where your ability to drive efficiency, ensure on-time delivery, and uphold quality standards will directly contribute to our success, while aligning the supply chain with the company's broader strategic vision.



Key Responsibilities

As the Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for leading and optimising key supply chain functions across inventory, logistics, procurement, and team management to support production and commercial goals. Your main responsibilities will include:



Inventory Planning & Management:

o Develop and maintain accurate inventory forecasts aligned with business needs

o Balance customer demand with inventory levels to optimise availability and minimise excess stock

o Analyse consumption patterns, seasonal trends, and market dynamics

o Manage repairable and unserviceable inventory, including buy-back processes

o Monitor inventory usage to identify obsolescence risks and recommend solutions

o Maintain stock accuracy through cycle counts, stocktakes, and proactive replenishment strategies

o Collaborate with suppliers to resolve issues, improve service levels, and support sourcing initiatives



Logistics Management:

o Oversee transportation services, including providers, freight costs, customs compliance, and export controls

o Ensure timely delivery of products and materials while optimising shipping efficiency

o Support warehousing operations, including material handling, storage, and dispatch

o Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in logistics and warehouse processes



Purchasing & Procurement:

o Maintain accurate supplier records and oversee onboarding of new vendors

o Manage requests for quotations (RFQs) and source suppliers to meet business requirements

o Maintain purchase orders and monitor subcontracted repair activities

o Evaluate vendor performance against quality, delivery, and cost standards

Export Control and Customs Compliance

o Provide support to Export Compliance Officer, Customs Compliance Officer and Empowered Official in the execution of Safran Export Control and Customs Compliance Standards.



Leadership & Team Management:

o Lead, coach, and manage the supply chain team to achieve high performance

o Manage staff qualifications, training, leave, and performance management

o Provide support to Procurement Coordinator, Warehouse Supervisor, and Noria/Warranty/Pool Coordinator
