title: Post-doc position at the Center for Migration and Integration at SSE
description:
About the Center for Migration and Integration Research

The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.  

About the position

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers contribute to:

    Conducting and publishing original research aligned with the Center’s thematic focus and scholarly ambition.  
    Collaborating with fellow researchers on interdisciplinary projects  
    Participating in the scholarly community through conferences and workshops
    Participating in the Center’s multistakeholder activities, e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums  
    Translating research findings into formats that are accessible to external audiences.

Your profile

The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications, and are keen to extend methodological and theoretical expertise in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably with a legal, economics or business focus connected to the fields of migration and integration. The center is led by the Center Director, Associate Professor Lin Lerpold, together with the Scientific Director, Professor Laurence Romani.

As a candidate, you thrive in a research environment directed towards impact, that is, a multidisciplinary and multi-paradigmatic environment where research aims at making contributions to both academic knowledge and a more sustainable society. You are open, considerate, and sympathetic to different research disciplines and paradigms such as positivist, interpretivist, and critical. You have strong qualities in both research and outreach communication activities.

While successful candidates are expected to master either qualitative or quantitative  methods, knowledge of and the ability to use both are a merit. Though research aims to be published in high-ranking international journals, an interest in the Swedish context within the larger EU frame, as well as sufficient reading and oral communication in Swedish is necessary. Beyond basic academic research, the successful candidates will be expected to contribute to, and participate in, the Center’s multistakeholder activities as well as communicate their research in policy and practitioner briefs.

The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and show an ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals. To be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement, while full proficiency in Swedish is an advantage. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm.

How to apply:

Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest October 30th, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:

    A curriculum vitae
    A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).
    Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)
    Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts
    Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references.

We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before October 30th, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around January 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of up to 18 months.

For further questions on the positions, please contact Lin Lerpold: lin.lerpold@hhs.se or Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se. For HR-related questions, contact Ellen Falkenström: ellen.falkenstrom@hhs.se.  

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Network Security (CISSP)
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
    Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
    Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
    Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
    Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
    Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

    Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
    Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
    Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).

    Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
    Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
    Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Benefits

    Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation and wellness allowance 4000 SEK/yearly
    Access to Benify, for discounts on e.g. Gym memberships, travel, hotels and many other great deals.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. title: Intensive Care Nurse for the ICU, Torsby Hospital
description:
We are looking for a dedicated Intensive Care (ICU) Nurse to join Torsby Hospital and work in a stimulating environment characterized by close collaboration and short decision-making paths. We are now looking for a new colleague to join our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) – someone who wants to be part of a committed team where we value one another and are passionate about making a difference every day.

About the position

We are looking for an ICU Nurse for a full-time position (100%).

As an ICU Nurse, you will provide advanced care to patients with a wide range of diagnoses and with threatened or confirmed failure of vital functions. In this role, you will monitor vital parameters and, when necessary, respond to changes in the patient's condition.

You will work as part of a team together with an assistant nurse and an anaesthesiologist. If a patient's condition changes during your shift, you will support one another and work together as a team. The work is varied and challenging and provides opportunities for continuous learning every day.

Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a registered nurse with at least three years of professional experience in intensive care, or a relevant specialist qualification in intensive care.

Personal qualities are important to us. We are looking for someone who is confident, reliable, and highly motivated. You are able to work independently, take initiative, and are prepared to act based on your professional assessment.

We value strong teamwork and communication skills, flexibility, and a strong commitment to quality. You are proactive and eager to contribute to the continued development of our services.

Your benefits as an employee

At Region Värmland, we have an important mission. We are here to help everyone in Värmland live healthy and fulfilling lives. As your employer, we therefore make sure to support and take care of you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

All our employees are entitled to at least 25 days of annual leave. As a new employee, you also earn paid vacation from your first day of employment. We offer more vacation days than required by Swedish law. We provide opportunities for learning and professional development as part of your daily work. We support you as an employee and create conditions for financial security throughout your working life. We offer attractive benefits and various insurance policies. We share knowledge, experience, and clear strategies to help you manage new challenges and quickly integrate into Swedish society. We also assist you and your family with the relocation and settlement process.

Your workplace

Our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) consists of ICU nurses, registered nurses, and assistant nurses. We have a positive working environment, take pride in our work, and value one another. We offer an individually tailored induction programme based on your experience and needs.

Torsby – Small in size, big on quality of life

Torsby is an ideal place for anyone who appreciates the tranquillity of nature combined with a strong sense of community and good services throughout the municipality. Here, you can enjoy all the advantages of a smaller town while having excellent opportunities for a relaxed lifestyle in beautiful surroundings.

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.



Your role

We are seeking a highly organized and relationship-driven IT Security Specialist to join our team at Business Area Surveillance. As an IT Security Specialist at Saab, you will work in an international context where advanced security threats, complex IT environments and high-impact business projects are part of the everyday business.

In this role, you will ensure the technical effectiveness of our Security Management System (SMS) by defining and validating the controls that secure our environment. You will be responsible for modernizing our technical oversight and bridging the gap between compliance requirements and operational reality. Acting as the primary lead for technical security validation, you will work closely with IT to provide the necessary oversight and ensure robust risk mitigation throughout the IT system lifecycle.



Your main tasks will be:

    Translate SMS and security requirements into technical standards, guidelines, and specifications.
    Turn security policies into practical technical solutions and secure system designs.
    Oversee the implementation of security controls across the IT lifecycle.
    Drive requirements for automation and digital tools to improve security monitoring and compliance.
    Validate technical compliance through reviews, audits, scans, and configuration assessments.
    Perform threat modeling and technical risk assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities.
    Partner with architects and system owners to ensure security by design.
    Act as the technical security expert, providing guidance and supporting risk-based decisions.



Preferred locations for this role are Solna/Stockholm or Kallebäck/Göteborg.



Your profile

Personal qualities are of paramount importance for this role. We are looking for someone with unwavering integrity, strong ethics, and a high level of trustworthiness. You should possess the ability to build and cultivate strong professional networks and relationships, both internally and externally.

You are a self-starter who can work independently while remaining a collaborative team player, always maintaining a focus on business and the collective result. Finally, you must have a mature understanding of "balanced security" - the ability to implement robust security measures that enable, rather than hinder, a business-driven environment.



Required skills:

    University degree and/or relevant experience in IT security, cybersecurity, computer science, or a related field.
    Experience translating security frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST 800-171, and/or KSF (Försvarsmaktens krav på säkerhetsfunktioner) into technical baselines and standards.
    Experience conducting technical risk assessments, threat modeling, and vulnerability analysis.
    Strong understanding of secure system design, networking, and security architecture.
    Ability to analyze technical findings and convert them into actionable remediation plans.
    Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security matters to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in Swedish and English.



Desired skills:

    Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA.
    Experience with cloud security, containerization, and microservice environments.
    Experience from the defense industry, government authorities, or global organizations.
    Knowledge of security tools such as vulnerability scanners, SIEM, and IAM solutions.
    Experience with DevSecOps, automation, and continuous compliance monitoring.
    Experience leading technical security initiatives or projects.



This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.



What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

If you are interested in what benefits you can take part of as an employee at Saab in Sweden, you can read more about them here

title: Experience Manager I EY wavespace | Stockholm
description:
The EY wavespace Nordic team is looking for a senior Experience Manager. You'll need deep experience leading and designing human-centred design and/or innovation processes. You'll manage and work with both internal and external stakeholders, shepherding them through ambiguity and opportunity to deliver impactful business results.





The opportunity



At EY wavespace, we like people who are good at the Reframe: taking an initial request and reframing that into a Better Question to solve for. Reframing business challenges as a platform for creating co-creation spaces and experiences is what we are best at. We're also looking for someone who really loves facilitating. Someone who leans into the challenge and messiness of bringing diverse groups of people together to accomplish something greater than the sum of the individuals.





Your key responsibilities



As an Experience Manager part of the EY Nordic wavespace team, you will have three essential responsibilities including 1) Managing projects, 2) Designing exceptional experiences and, 3) Facilitating experiences.



    Managing projectsManaging internal and external stakeholders through our process.
    Building strong relationships across EY to increase opportunities for wavespace.
     Designing exceptional experiencesUncovering the true client need and desired outcome of a wavespace.
    Designing workshops and that drive collaboration, creativity, and concrete outcomes.
    Partnering with Experience Designers to create impactful and memorable experiences.
    Facilitating experiencesAs lead facilitator you will need to know how to get the best out of people, how to manage time, energy and conflicts, and to hold a room.

Skills and attributes for success





Qualifications

Meritorious

As a person you are



    Eager to with work with diverse teams and personalities

What we offer you



At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

title: PhD student in ultrafast spectroscopy of organic semiconductors
description:
We are looking to recruit a PhD researcher in the group of Dr. Gillett in the Electronic and Photonic Materials division in the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (IFM). The successful applicant will work in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB on a research project funded by the Åforsk Foundation that will use ultrafast optical spectroscopy to understand the degradation mechanisms of organic photovoltaics. The recruited researcher will also have the opportunity to take advantage of the state-of-the-art spectroscopy setups developed in the group to pursue their own research interests more broadly in the field of organic materials. Topics currently being studied in the group include organic photovoltaic and OLED systems, vibronic coupling in organic molecules, molecular photoswitches, circularly polarized luminescence, and photocatalysis.

Your work assignments

This project aims to understand the stability and failure mechanisms in the light-absorbing layer of organic photovoltaic devices under conditions relevant to commercial applications. To achieve this, we will take a unique approach that involves using ultrafast optical spectroscopy techniques to probe how material degradation impacts the fundamental photophysics of the organic materials that underpin device operation (see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2023.03.002 for a recent example of this approach from the group). This project will be carried out in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB (https://www.epishine.com/), also based in Linköping, who are currently working on the commercialization of organic photovoltaics for indoor light harvesting applications.

You will be responsible for performing transient absorption spectroscopy measurements, spanning the visible to mid-infrared, on organic photovoltaic samples provided by Epishine AB to understand how the photophysics of these materials change after different material degradation protocols. This will be supplemented by steady-state spectroscopy measurements (UVVis, photoluminescence/PLQY, FTIR), as well as morphology and computational characterization through collaborators, to provide a complete picture of the degradation mechanism under real-world conditions. Through this, you will provide new design rules for organic photovoltaic materials that will have a direct impact on commercial applications of the technology.

In addition, Dr. Gillett strongly encourages his research group to follow their curiosity and develop their own research projects. Therefore, the successful candidate will also have the freedom to explore other topics during their PhD within the broader fields of organic materials and ultrafast spectroscopy. Through this, you will have the opportunity to develop as an independent researcher ready to pursue an academic or industrial career path.

As a PhD student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research projects of which you are part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20 per cent of full-time.

Your qualifications

You have graduated at Master’s level in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related discipline, or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be in advanced courses. Alternatively, you have gained essentially corresponding knowledge in another way.

In addition, the following are requirements for the role:

    Previous experience working with organic or perovskite materials.
    A high level of self-motivation and independence, good problem-solving skills, and the demonstrated ability to work in a team.
    The ability to fluently communicate in English (written and spoken).

The following requirements are not essential, but considered highly beneficial for the role:

    Previous experience working on organic photovoltaic materials and devices, including stability measurements
    Experience of independently performing ultrafast optical spectroscopy measurements, including, but not limited to, transient absorption and time-resolved photoluminescence
    Experience of working with laser systems, in particular femtosecond and nanosecond pulsed laser sources
    Good coding skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, LabView) for the development of custom code for running experiments and analysing experimental data

Finally, a letter of intent should be attached to the application covering how your background and skills make you a good match for the research project on organic photovoltaics. In addition, please provide a short description of your own research interests and a potential idea for another research project that you would like to explore in the group. Note that this doesn’t necessarily have to be in the area of organic photovoltaics.

Your workplace

You will be employed in the research group led by Dr. Alexander Gillett (https://liu.se/en/employee/alegi69), located in the Electronic and Photonic Materials Division: https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm/efm. Here, you will be part of a small (currently the PI and ~5 researchers) and supportive team where the freedom to think critically and define your own research path is strongly encouraged.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies.

The employment has a duration of normally four years’ full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of teaching and institutional assignment. Further extensions may be granted in exceptional circumstances. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time, depending on your progress through the study plan.

Starting date by agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than 5th of October 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior lecturer in dairy cow management
description:
Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science

The Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare

Our aim is to advance responsible animal management, welfare, and sustainable food production while ensuring high product quality. Through research and education, we focus on feed and nutrition, management and environment, ethology and animal ethics, as well as animal welfare and protection.

Subject description

The subject focuses on how the housing and management of dairy cows affect their health, welfare and productivity, as well as the sustainability of dairy production. It also covers the interactions between animals, their environment, technology and people at both farm and system levels.

Duties

The applicant will be responsible for developing research and teaching within the subject area, in collaboration with other researchers at the faculty and across the university. The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of teaching and learning within the subject area.

The research can be based on controlled experiments as well as production data from commercial farms, questionnaire-based studies and modelling.

The applicant will be expected to:

    develop and lead internationally successful research;
    develop, lead and participate in teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    primarily teach within animal sciences, in addition to other components at first, second and third cycle level covering the subject;
    develop and maintain national and international networks with academia, the relevant public authorities, industry, organisations and society at large;
    collaborate with other SLU research teams to strengthen interdisciplinary activities at the university;
    apply for external research funding from both national and international sources;
    supervise doctoral students;
    contribute to the strategic development of the department, faculty and SLU;
    communicate research findings and other relevant information to society at large;
    be able to teach in Swedish within four years;
    be able to participate in discussions with colleagues and stakeholders in the sector, as well as carry out administrative duties in Swedish, within four years.

The department uses Swedish and English in parallel. The senior lecturer should be able to perform the majority of their tasks in English. However, as a public authority, the university has Swedish as its main language according to the requirements of the Language Act and the senior lecturer must be able to use Swedish as their working language within four years of beginning the position. The department will provide support with language learning.

Eligibility

The applicant must:

    have successfully completed a doctoral degree or have the equivalent academic qualifications within a subject relevant to the position;
    demonstrate research expertise in the subject for the appointment;
    demonstrate teaching expertise and have the ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into their teaching;
    have experience of teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    have good knowledge of English;
    have a valid driving licence for passenger car.

Assessment criteria

The assessment criteria for appointment must be the degree of expertise required as qualification for employment.

The assessment of research expertise will be based on:

    completed and ongoing research and its relevance and development potential for the faculty and department;
    the ability to independently initiate and run successful and internationally-recognised research;
    the ability to compete for external research funding;
    experience as a supervisor in doctoral education.

The following will be taken into consideration when assessing teaching expertise:

    planning, implementation, examination and assessment of own teaching;
    supervision and examination at first and second cycle level;
    ability to integrate research and scientific approaches into teaching work;
    training in teaching and learning in higher education, or equivalent knowledge acquired in other ways;
    pedagogic vision and reflection;
    documented pedagogical ability.

The following abilities will also be assessed:

    developing and leading activities and staff within academia;
    communicating and collaborating internally;
    collaborating with external stakeholders and society;
    communicating research and development work.

It is an advantage if the applicant has an established network within the sector in Sweden or internationally.

The appointment will be offered to the applicant who, following a qualitative comprehensive assessment is in the best position to conduct and develop the duties in question, and contribute to the positive development of the organisation.

Additional information

* Swedish “universitetslektor”, a tenured position approximately equivalent to Senior lecturer (UK) or Associate professor (US). The applicant who is offered this employment at SLU will be employed as Senior lecturer.

Application deadline: 2026-11-23

Place of work: Uppsala

Scope: 100 %

Form of Employment: Permanent employment.

Starting date: By agreement.

Application:

For the guidance of your application, there is SLU's appointment procedure for teachers at SLU and General assessment criteria for the appointment of teachers.

Please apply by clicking the apply-button.

title: Group IT Director
description:
TitanX is a global partner to commercial vehicles manufacturers for heat transfer. Our mission is to provide innovative and competitive thermal management solutions to accelerate the effort for a greener transport.

On the road to a more sustainable future, with the support of TataAutoComp Systems our owner, we are expanding our thermal management product portfolio to bring innovative solutions for a cleaner and electrical transport. In parallel, we bring our performing heat transfer technology to other segments such as off-road and industrial applications.

At TitanX every team member is relied upon to make a difference, contribute with innovative ideas and add value to the company. Our decision paths are short; we act with speed and own the outcome. We are one global team and achieve better results together.

We are looking for a Group IT Director to lead and further develop our global IT organization across TitanX.This is a key leadership role combining IT strategy with the operational needs of an international manufacturing business. You will be responsible for Infrastructure & Business Services, Operational Technology (OT), Information & Cyber Security and plant-level IT support.Working closely with the Group CDO, Operations and business leaders, you will shape the future IT landscape, strengthen IT/OT collaboration and ensure secure and reliable technology support across the Group.The role offers significant impact and the opportunity to drive the further development and transformation of IT within TitanX.

Your responsibilities

    Define and execute the Group IT strategy and roadmap together with the Group CDO, balancing long-term development with the operational needs of our manufacturing plants.
    Lead and develop the global IT organization covering Infrastructure & Help Desk, Operational Technology, Information & Cyber Security and plant-level IT support.
    Ensure reliable and secure IT operations across the Group, including infrastructure, networks, cloud services and effective day-to-day support for manufacturing and business functions.
    Develop the IT/OT landscape, strengthening the connection between corporate IT and factory systems, including MES, Industrial IoT and PLC environments, while driving the roadmap for legacy systems.
    Own the Group's approach to cybersecurity, IT risk, business continuity, disaster recovery and incident response, including cooperation with external SOC/MDR providers.
    Manage the Group IT budget, investment portfolio and strategic vendor relationships, including outsourcing/MSP partnerships and contract negotiations.
    Partner with Operations and other business functions on digitalization initiatives, ensuring effective prioritization and transition of solutions between IT, OT and Operations.
    Act as a trusted IT partner for plant management, business leaders and Group Management, while building and developing a strong global IT team.

Our requirements

    University degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent professional experience.
    At least 10 years of relevant IT experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Proven experience leading multi-site or international IT organizations and working in a cross-cultural environment. Collaboration with teams in India would be an advantage.
    Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and Operational Technology (OT), including manufacturing environments such as MES, Industrial IoT and PLC-based systems.
    Strong understanding of cybersecurity, IT risk, business continuity and disaster recovery.
    Experience managing IT budgets, investments, strategic vendors and outsourcing partners.
    Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and senior business leaders.
    A pragmatic, hands-on mindset and the ability to balance strategic development with operational reality.
    Fluent English.

What we offer

    Stable employment in very dynamic and international automotive environment
    A key leadership role with a real impact on the Group IT strategy and future technology landscape.
    Company car
    A flexible working model, combining remote work with presence at our locations when needed.
    Good work conditions including additional benefits
    Friendly atmosphere, respect and support

title: Global Sales Developer - Mining
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

Mining is an attractive growth market for Alfa Laval, driven by increasing demand for critical and base minerals and a growing focus on more sustainable and efficient mining operations. As part of our global Process Mining Separation team, you will contribute to strengthening Alfa Laval's position in the mining market by turning market knowledge, customer relationships and new opportunities into business.



As Global Sales Developer - Mining, you will work closely with customers, sales companies and colleagues across the global organization to identify where we can grow and how we can win. You will contribute your market insights and ideas to the sales strategy, develop opportunities together with the team, and help turn agreed priorities into commercial results. Key responsibilities include:

Build and strengthen relationships with mining customers, sales companies and external partners.

    

Contribute customer and market insights to sales strategy, including target customers, applications and market priorities.

    

Work with the global team to explore and develop opportunities across different regions and technology conversion.

    

Build partnerships that support Alfa Laval's growth and position within the mining industry.

    

Follow market trends, customer needs and industry developments to identify new business opportunities.

    

Contribute to external messaging and market activities that position Alfa Laval's decanter technology as a sustainable solution for mining operations.



Who are you

You are a commercially driven and proactive person who enjoys being close to the market, building relationships and turning ideas into contracts. You are curious and open to learning, while confident enough to challenge ideas, share your perspective and stand behind your recommendations. You influence through credibility, dialogue and persuasion, and you value finding the right solution together with others rather than competing for ownership. You are comfortable working in a global team, take initiative when you see an opportunity, and maintain your drive when building a market requires persistence and patience.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you combine strong commercial understanding with a technical mindset and the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.

    

Several years of experience in a technical-commercial, sales or business development role in mining.

    

Strong commercial and business orientation, with a track record of developing customer relationships and sales opportunities.

    

Engineering degree or equivalent technical education.

    

Technical background, preferably within separation technologies, process equipment or a related field.

    

Knowledge and experience from the mining industry.

    

Ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer needs and business value.

    

Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interact with customers, partners and internal stakeholders at different levels.

    

Fluent English. Spanish is an advantage.



What's in it for you

You will join a global team working in an attractive and evolving mining market, with significant opportunities to grow Alfa Laval's presence and impact. The role gives you broad exposure to customers, markets and sales organizations across the world, while allowing you to work alongside colleagues with deep technical and industry expertise. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing business area and play a visible role in bringing more sustainable separation solutions to the mining industry.

title: SSAB - Design Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about engineering, product development, and innovative vehicle design? We are looking for a Design Specialist to join the expert team at SSAB Knowledge Service Center.

SSAB is a globally recognized leader in advanced high-strength steels, helping automotive manufacturers build safer, lighter, and more sustainable vehicles. In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials technology, structural analysis, and forming simulation to support the development of next-generation automotive solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with customers, and using advanced simulation tools to turn innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable products.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional with strong analytical skills, deep technical expertise, and a genuine interest in product development, structural analysis, and sheet metal forming. Location: Borlänge

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

About the position

As a Design Specialist, you will provide expert guidance on structural performance, forming feasibility, simulation methods, material behavior, and application development. Your expertise will help customers optimize components and structures for performance, manufacturability, and sustainability using SSAB’s portfolio of advanced steel grades.

You will focus on the mobility segment, developing conceptual designs, evaluating structural performance, and predicting manufacturing outcomes, often in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers.

Your daily work will include structural analyses, forming simulations, material data evaluation, method development, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

You will join a highly skilled team of steel experts who combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.  

Main responsibilities

    Develop design concepts that illustrate the benifits and applications of advanced steel grades
    Collaborate with automotive customers in designing and optimizing components and body structures  
    Perform structural analyses using finite element methods (FEM) to assess structural performance and lightweighting possibilities
    Conduct forming simulations to evaluate manufacturability and process robustness
    Develop and validate simulation methodologies, material models, and engineering workflows
    Provide customers and colleagues with technical expertise in structural performance, forming processes, material behavior, and design optimization
    Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, seminars, and presentations tailored to customers and business needs



About you

    A master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, materials engineering, engineering physics, vehicle engineering, or a related field
    At least five years of experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or engineering industry
    Solid knowledge of and experience in structural analysis and/or sheet metal forming simulation.  
    Experience using CAE tools such as LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, AutoForm, or PAM-STAMP
    Excellent written and spoken English



To thrive and succeed in this role, you should also:

    Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
    Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions
    See the big picture and connect technical details to broader business needs
    Contribute as a collaborative team player  



It is an advantage if you have:

    Experience in automotive product development, body-in-white engineering, crash analysis, durability, or lightweight design
    Knowledge of advanced high-strength steels and their use in automotive structures
    Knowledge of Swedish and a strong ambition to become fluent

Our offer

We offer a range of valued employee benefits, including:

    Profit sharing
    Improved work-life balance through reduced working hours
    Wellness grants

Recruitment process

    Application
    Assessments
    Interview
    Reference check
    Health examination
    Offer and contract signing

A background check may form part of the recruitment process. The health examination includes drug testing.

Questions? Contact us about this position

Email linda.petersson@ssab.com

Trade union information is provided by Akademikerföreningen, Unionen, and Ledarna, who can be reached through our switchboard at +46 243 700 00.

A message from your future manager

“At the Knowledge Service Center, our multi-site team of 25 skilled experts works closely with SSAB’s customers to develop new solutions and technologies and solve unique challenges. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, innovate, and create value.

If you are passionate about product development, structural analysis, and engineering innovation, you will find exciting challenges and great colleagues here. We look forward to welcoming you to our team.”

Linda Petersson

Head of Knowledge Service Center, SSAB Europe

title: Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: R&D Sustainability, Compliance and Quality Manager.

As Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist, you will drive regulatory intelligence, stakeholder engagement, and advocacy activities that support compliance, business continuity, and growth. In this highly visible role, you will monitor regulatory developments, assess business impacts, and help shape strategies that align global regulatory requirements with ABB's business objectives.

Our division, IEC LV Motors, holds a market‑leading position by delivering exceptional customer value in efficiency, reliability, and safety - the attributes most valued by our customers and partners. Our strength lies in deep domain expertise and a strong global presence, combined with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, quality, reliability, and safety. Our commitment is to empower our customers with innovative solutions that drive productivity and enhance energy efficiency through our unmatched application expertise and technology leadership, delivering tailored solutions and a first-class customer experience.  The outcome of your work will have a direct impact on our division.

You will work closely with colleagues across R&D, Product Management, Sustainability, Trade Compliance and Supply Chain, while also representing ABB in industry associations, technical forums, and discussions with policymakers and regulatory stakeholders.     Monitor and assess international, regional, and national regulatory developments affecting the IEC Low Voltage Motors business.

    Collaborate across multiple functions to provide regulatory guidance and support product, technology, and business decisions.
    Develop and deliver awareness and training initiatives that strengthen regulatory knowledge and promote a culture of compliance.

The position is based in Sweden (Vasteras), Finland (Vaasa) or Germany (Mannheim). We offer a hybrid working model; however, the role requires regular on-site presence at the local office.

Qualifications

     Several years of experience working with regulatory affairs, standards development, public affairs, compliance, or related fields in an international environment.

    Proven ability to influence and collaborate across functions and with external stakeholders, including industry associations, government agencies, and policymakers.

    Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Political Science, International Studies, or another relevant discipline.

title: Quality Assurance Engineering Leader
description:
Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.



Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.  

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a typical day, you will:

    Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.  
    Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.  
    Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.  
    Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.  
    Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.  
    Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.  
    Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.  
    Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.  
    Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.  
    Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

    Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.  
    Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
    Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.  
    Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.  
    Coach and support engineering teams in adopting quality-first ways of working and embedding quality throughout the development lifecycle.  
    Advocate for early defect prevention through practices such as automation, clear requirements, and decoupled architectures.  
    Communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, both verbally and in writing.  
    Be a trusted subject matter expert in quality assurance, providing guidance on specialist QA approaches when needed.  
    Have experience of building and maintaining modern test automation frameworks for web using Playwright, Cypress or similar, including custom framework design in JavaScript/TypeScript with deep CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

    Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking
    Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.  
    Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 8th of October.

This is a full-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.

title: Senior Projektledare
description:
Om Multiply & VisFlow

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet end to end solution provider som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, systemdesign och datadrivna plattformar. Tillsammans med VisFlow – vår egen produkt för strukturerad, visuell och spårbar teknisk kunskap – hjälper vi organisationer att bygga, driva och vidareutveckla komplexa system inom säkerhetskritiska och dataintensiva domäner.

VisFlow omvandlar komplexa tekniska processer, systemflöden och operativ kunskap till tydliga, visuella och sammanlänkade representationer. Plattformen gör det möjligt för team att förstå, förvalta och skala avancerade system genom hela livscykeln – från utveckling och införande till drift och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Rollen

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet konsultbolag som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad systemutveckling, mjukvara och komplexa industriella miljöer. Vi arbetar med uppdrag där struktur, tillit och genomförandekraft är avgörande – ofta i säkerhetskritiska sammanhang.

Vi söker nu en Senior Projektledare för uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin, där du får ett tydligt mandat och ett stort ansvar att leda komplexa projekt från start till mål.

Om rollen

Som senior projektledare ansvarar du för helheten i projektleveransen. Du leder och samordnar projektteam, skapar tydlig struktur och säkerställer framdrift i alla projektets faser – från initiering till avslut. Rollen kräver stark kommunikativ förmåga, hög integritet och vana att arbeta nära både styrgrupp och operativa team.

Ansvarsområden

    Leda och samordna projektteam i komplexa miljöer
    Engagera och inspirera team mot gemensamma mål
    Planera, organisera och följa upp projektets samtliga faser
    Rapportera tydlig och korrekt status till styrgrupp och intressenter
    Kommunicera effektivt med interna och externa parter
    Säkerställa rätt förutsättningar och arbeta proaktivt med hinder
    Identifiera, mitigera och rapportera risker
    Dokumentera och strukturera beslut, åtgärder och lärdomar
    Bygga starka relationer och långsiktigt förtroende
    Leda styrgruppsmöten och säkerställa rätt stöd vid rätt tid

Kvalifikationer

    Minst 10 års erfarenhet i ledande roller, varav flera år som projektledare
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin
    God förståelse för arbete i säkerhetsklassade miljöer
    Godkänd säkerhetsprövning (krav)

title: Thesis project: Pallet perception through deep learning and sensor fusion
description:
Develop methods using deep learning models to improve the current pallet perception system, with a focus on fusing model outputs with data from other sensors. The main focus will be on general pallet identification and localization.

In your Master Thesis at Toyota, you will work on:

A modern sensor system featuring:

    2D RGB camera
    Time-of-Flight (ToF) 3D camera
    Correlation between pixels from the RGB camera and points in the 3D point cloud from the ToF camera
    NVIDIA chip in an embedded environment (GPU) for data processing

Tasks include:

    Training and evaluation of deep learning (DL) models using different methodologies
    Algorithm development for data fusion
    Evaluation using real-world data and comparison with training results from a synthetic environment

At Toyota, we work with innovative technologies to develop our autonomous trucks. The thesis project will investigate training methodologies, model architecture, and the selection of suitable model outputs that can be effectively combined with point cloud data to accurately localize a pallet in relation to the camera position. The training data will be generated in synthetic environments, which will be provided as part of the project. Therefore, the gap between synthetic and real-world data will also need to be considered when evaluating the results. The thesis project will be carried out in close collaboration with one of Toyota's teams specializing in machine learning development.

SCOPE
Master thesis 30 hp, 1-2 students

Requirements
For this master thesis, we are looking for students with following education or equivalent:

    3D Computer vision
    Deep learning specialization / Machine Learning specialization

Who is Toyota Material Handling?
Toyota Material Handling is a global leader in material handling, and we are making significant investments to meet the needs of the future. At our site in Mjölby, 3,000 employees work across the entire material handling value chain, from development concepts to finished vehicles. Our product range spans from manual hand trucks to autonomous vehicles and innovative energy solutions.

At Toyota Material Handling, we strive to create a friendly, safe and forward-thinking workplace. Our culture is built on Toyota's core values, where respect and consideration guide us in our daily work. Our ambition is to strengthen our competitiveness by increasing diversity across the organization and embracing our differences.

Start
January 2027

Your application can be written in English or Swedish.

title: Marketing Director
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY Tiger of Sweden is a Stockholm-based fashion house established in 1903 with a heritage in tailoring. For more than a century, Tiger of Sweden has stood for style with purpose, dressing men and women for whom true style is about the confidence to be themselves.

POSITION OVERVIEW As Marketing Director, you will build brand equity, elevate brand visibility, and fuel brand desirability for Tiger of Sweden globally. You should possess a deep understanding of brand strategy, consumer behaviour, and digital marketing, along with a proven track record of developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will set the brand strategy, lead all marketing, PR and campaign work, and build a high-performing Marketing & PR team across locations. You will work closely with the CEO and the entire management team, and represent the brand externally to agencies, press, industry opinion leaders, fashion influencers and celebrities. The role involves regular travel.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Customer Insight:

    

Set the brand strategy for Tiger of Sweden, from target customer to visual identity and tone of voice, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Create a distinctive and inspiring brand community around Tiger of Sweden at a global scale.

    

Gain a deep understanding of current and target customers through qualitative and quantitative research and the Tiger Society customer database.

    

Share customer insights with the commercial, design, and product functions.

    

Ensure a consistent tone of voice across all channels globally (English, German, Swedish).

    

Act as the brand's north star, safeguarding 360-degree consistency across all owned and third-party channels.

Marketing, Campaigns & PR:

    

Develop and implement annual, seasonal, and project-based marketing and PR strategies.

    

Lead the conception, creation, and production (film, photo, editorial) of all marketing campaigns, in alignment with the CEO.

    

Lead the cross-functional 360 marketing and sales calendar planning and the weekly editorial meeting.

    

Drive online and offline media coverage, ensuring both quality and scale.

    

Drive the global influencer marketing strategy to increase visibility and awareness on social media.

    

Oversee and set a structure for global and local agencies and third-party service providers.

Retail, Store Concept & Events:

    

Lead the store design concept for all points of sale, directing external partners and delivering projects on time and on budget.

    

Co-develop in-store activations and create seasonal and theme-based window concepts.

    

Plan and manage brand events, such as fashion presentations, influencer experiences, store events, panel talks and live shopping.

    

Co-lead line release meetings with Sales and Design, and support selling-in with brand material such as lookbooks, virtual showrooms and brand presentations.

    

Support the Wholesale, Retail and eCom teams in reaching commercial targets.

    

Direct the creation of all branding-relevant physical assets, from stationery to packaging and signage.

Brand Development & Partnerships:

    

Develop a long-term licensing strategy, identifying suitable partners and setting up brand-enhancing, commercially attractive agreements.

    

Act as a brand ambassador for Tiger of Sweden.

Team Leadership & Budget:

    

Lead, develop, and mentor the Marketing & PR team, empowering existing talent to deliver excellence.

    

Manage the global Marketing & PR budget.

    

Set up relevant KPIs and reviews to ensure efficient and effective budget allocation, taking corrective action as needed.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

    

10+ years of experience in Marketing & PR.

    

Proven track record in developing strategies and driving results for global fashion brands.

    

Experience working for a global fashion brand, preferably in a premium or luxury environment.

    

Experience directing creative and art direction for a global fashion or lifestyle brand.

    

Excellent knowledge of digital marketing, sales channels, and the latest digital trends.

    

Experience managing external agencies and senior, high-profile stakeholders.

    

Proven people leader with the ability to build successful cross-functional partnerships.

    

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English.

    

Strong eye for brand-consistent visual storytelling.

    

Highly organised, able to juggle priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    

Creative, entrepreneurial and results-driven.

    

Culturally aware and highly engaged in the industry, current trends and events.

    

Team player with a positive, can-do attitude.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

    

Microsoft Office

The position is based in our Head Office in Stockholm and is a full-time position. Does this sound like the perfect fit for you? Please don't hesitate to apply by submitting a CV and personal letter in English. We look forward to receiving your application.

Tiger of Sweden stands against any form of discrimination and strives to be an inclusive brand and workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race or disability, and recruitment is based purely on skills and experience.

title: Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist
description:
Join Telavox as a Backend Software Engineer – AI Assist 🤖

Are you a backend engineer who wants to see AI run in production, not in a demo? AI Assist turns every recorded phone call on the Telavox platform into a transcript, a summary and action items for the people who took the call. We are looking for an engineer who is at home where distributed systems, telephony, and large language models meet.

In this role, placed in Malmö or Stockholm, you'll build and run the services behind AI Assist: turning a finished call into text and insight, and delivering the result to our apps and our admin portal. You'll work in a small team with a lot of ownership, shaping what to build together with the product manager day to day, and what you ship reaches real customers and partners the same week.

If you'd like to take the next step in your career and are excited by the challenge of making AI dependable at scale, this is your opportunity!

About the job

AI Assist is live today, sold both directly and through telecom operators across Europe, and usage is growing month over month. You'll join the team that owns it end to end, from the transcription pipeline to the APIs our apps and customers use. Much of the work is classic backend engineering with an AI twist: asynchronous processing, third-party model APIs, access control, metering, and data that has to be handled correctly under GDPR and EU data-residency requirements.

You'll work side by side with a colleague focused on model evaluation and transcription quality, with the AI Agents team next door building our AI agent platform, and with the telephony, apps and platform teams whose systems yours plug into.

Our stack: Java and Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Google Vertex AI with Gemini and other model providers for transcription and analysis.

Your day-to-day work may include:

    

Designing, implementing and testing new capabilities in the AI service, from summaries a customer can shape themselves to the controls an admin needs to roll the product out.

    

Evolving the transcription pipeline together with the telephony and platform teams.

    

Integrating LLM and speech APIs in a production setting: asynchronous processing, quotas and rate limits, and keeping data within the EU.

    

Building the APIs that serve transcripts to our apps, our admin portal and our customers, with access control and data retention done right.

    

Owning what you ship: observability, alerting, and the follow-up when something fails.

About you

You're a product-minded backend engineer who likes owning a service from design to production, and who is comfortable in a system that spans several teams and a telephony platform with two decades of history. You care about correctness where it matters (who may read what, what is stored for how long, what a customer is billed for), and you enjoy the pace of a small team with customers and partners waiting for what you build. You don't need to be an AI researcher. You need to be the engineer who makes AI dependable.

Key skills and experience we're looking for:

    

Several years building backend services in Java, preferably with Spring Boot

    

Strong understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and system integration across service boundaries

    

Experience running services in production: monitoring, observability, and debugging in a distributed system

    

Experience with relational databases and queue-based or job-based architectures

    

Proficient in English, both spoken and written

Good-to-have skills:

    

Python, which we use alongside Java across the AI domain

    

Experience calling LLM or speech-to-text APIs from production code (Gemini, OpenAI or similar)

    

Experience deploying and running services on Kubernetes

    

Familiarity with telephony concepts (SIP, call recording, PBX) or with GDPR and data-residency requirements in practice

Join us at Telavox 💚

Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.

Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!

How to apply!

At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

title: Junior konsult till Financial Accounting Advisory Services | Göteborg
description:
Are your ready to shape your future with confidence?



Företag utvecklar ständigt sin verksamhet genom att lansera nya produkter, säkra ny finansiering, genomföra fusioner och utföra börsintroduktioner. Det är avgörande för företagsledningen att dessa strategiska initiativ presenteras i de finansiella rapporterna på ett sätt som återspeglar den affärsmässiga avsikten.

    Transaktionsrelaterade frågeställningar inom finansiell rapportering

Kvalifikationer

    Universitets-/högskoleexamen inom ekonomi, företrädesvis med inriktning mot externredovisning eller finans

    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

    Analytisk och lösningsorienterad med ett skarpt kritiskt tänkande

    Ett intresse för att arbeta i och driva projekt  
    Förmågan att bygga förtroenden och relationer samt uppskattar att arbeta i team  

    Proaktiv inställning, är nyfiken och har förmågan att driva dig själv framåt

    Mycket goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint och Word)

    Masterexamen

    Goda akademiska meriter, relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, utlandsstudier och/eller engagemang utanför studierna

    Erfarenhet av att tillämpa AI för att skapa affärsnytta och effektivisera processer

    Kontinuerligt lärande: Du utvecklar tankesätt och färdigheter som hjälper dig att navigera in i framtiden.

    Framgång så som du definierar den: Vi ger dig verktygen och flexibiliteten, så att du kan göra skillnad på ditt sätt.

    Transformativt ledarskap: Vi ger dig insikter, coachning och självförtroende för att bli den ledare som världen behöver.

    Inkluderande kultur: Du kommer att accepteras för den du är och få möjlighet att använda din röst för att hjälpa andra att hitta sin.

Om du har frågor, behöver stöd, eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte på att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Torsby Hospital, Sweden is looking for specialist in internal medicine
description:
The Medical department at Torsby Hospital is looking for a specialist in internal medicine to become one of the consultant physicians in our team.

Torsby hospital is a pleasant workplace with a friendly atmosphere delivering high quality medical care. Learn more about the position and apply today!

Torsby hospital is a district hospital with 24/7 emergency services. It is situated in the north of the beautiful Värmland county. We serve a population of 40,000 inhabitants in the municipalities of Torsby, Sunne, Hagfors and Munkfors. Our goal is to deliver high quality medical care that contributes to a world-class quality of life for our citizens.

The hospital has a medical department and a department of surgery, orthopaedics and anaesthetics. There are 48 inpatient beds on three wards and an ICU with 4 beds. We have a modern operating theatre and an endoscopy unit. Our emergency department is open 24/7 and staffed by medical, surgical and orthopaedic doctors on call. We also have an outpatients department with specialised clinics.

In the medical department we take care of patients with a broad spectrum  of medical conditions, both as inpatients and in the outpatient department. We have a special focus on cardiology, stroke patients, gastroenterology, endocrinology and rheumatology. We also have a mobile team delivering care to palliative patients and patients with advanced medical illnesses.

Torsby hospital is a pleasant workplace with several advantages. We are known for our friendly atmosphere and excellent cooperation between the different staff categories and the different departments. The decision making paths are short and efficient. We are constantly striving to ensure the best possible working environment for all staff at the hospital. These features are the basis that enables us to deliver high quality care to our patients.

Work with us - Region Värmland

Living in Torsby you can enjoy life in the countryside while at the same time having all necessary facilities for daily life and all school types in close proximity.

As a specialist in internal medicine, you will be part of our team of seven consultants and about 14 junior doctors in training. You should have a broad knowledge in internal medicine and feel comfortable in treating acutely ill patients with a wide range of medical ailments.  You will be responsible for the care of inpatients on the ward and outpatients in your clinic. At the clinic, there is the opportunity for you to focus on certain groups of patients. After sufficient introduction you will also be taking part in the on call roster as a backup for the junior college on call. You will get the chance to advance to a consultant position. There is also the possibility to complete subspecialty training.

We can offer you:

    Work at a small hospital with full emergency services, short decision making paths and outstanding working atmosphere.
    A teaching hospital that has been recognised for its high quality
    A management team that cares about you
    Nice accommodation close to nature
    Help with finding accommodation
    Good connections to the international airports in Oslo and Stockholm
    A high quality of life with the possibility to engage in a wide range of outdoor activities from fishing and hunting to mountain biking and skiing
    A health promoting workplace with access to wellness activities and wellness allowances

Read more at Work with us.

Language training and introduction program

We offer Swedish language course and introduction program.

We can share knowledge, experience and clear strategies for handling new challenges and for integrating quickly into the Swedish society. We can also offer help for you and your family with relocation and with establishing yourselves. Read more at Ny i Värmland.

Your rights and benefits as an employee

The following are some of our rights and benefits:

    All our employees receive at least 25 days of holiday, and as a new employee your paid leave will accrue from day one.
    We give employees the possibility of learning and developing their skills in the daily work.
    We take care of you as an employee and we also provide opportunities for a life-long financial security for you. We have good benefits and different insurances.
    Most of our services have the possibility of flexible working hours.
    We want to promote health and wellness for all employees. An important part of the health promotion work is the wellness allowance.

A more pleasant life in Värmland

    An open and welcoming environment, an international business community, a strong storytelling tradition, inspiring culture, sports and outdoor life and an innovative university.
    Read more about Värmland.
    Read more about Nordvärmland.

You are welcome to contact us on email for more information:

Jeanette Arvidsson jeanette.e.arvidsson@regionvarmland.se, Head of department.

Tanja Ihle, tanja.ihle@regionvarmland.se, Specialist internal medicin.

Rekrytering.utland@regionvarmland.se  for questions about our Swedish course, relocation and introduction.

Welcome to Region Värmland!
